name: @securefabric/client
description: Typed client for the SecureFabric API, generated from its FastAPI OpenAPI schema

scripts.check-generated: cd ../.. && uv run --frozen securefabric-openapi | pnpm -C packages/client exec openapi-typescript --enum-values --default-non-nullable=false --check -o ./src/v1.ts
scripts.dev: cd ../.. && uv run --frozen watchfiles --filter python --ignore-paths .venv,node_modules "pnpm -C packages/client run sync" apps/api/src packages/core/src packages/tasks/src packages/domain/src
scripts.generate: cd ../.. && uv run --frozen securefabric-openapi | pnpm -C packages/client exec openapi-typescript --enum-values --default-non-nullable=false -o ./src/v1.ts
scripts.sync: pnpm run --silent check-generated >/dev/null 2>&1 || pnpm run generate
